usage.danger_layered: Play forest_danger_layer_30s.wav synchronized at the same playhead as the normal loop (fade its volume up/down), or switch to forest_danger_full_loop_30s.wav at same playhead. Do not play danger full and danger layer simultaneously.
usage.victory: Fade or stop the loop, then play forest_victory_stinger.wav once.
usage.sfx: Play individual files on matching player/game events.

note: Original programmatically synthesized chiptune audio. WAVs have short endpoint fades to avoid clicks. Exported standalone SFX.
